description: This Swift source file defines the AppLockManager class, responsible for managing application lock state and biometric authentication within an iOS app; it provides methods to lock/unlock the app and handles biometric authentication prompts.

classes.name: AppLockManager
classes.description: A class that manages app lock state and biometric authentication logic.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the app UI until the user authenticates.

methods.name: unlockWithoutPrompt
methods.description: Unlocks the app UI without prompting for biometrics; used after logout.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Attempts to unlock using biometrics or passcode asynchronously.

methods.name: lockAndRequireAuthIfNeeded
methods.description: Locks the app and requests authentication if the app lock is enabled; called when returning to foreground.
